name: TRAU
decision_note: Prague design studio that since May 2026 also makes small angel-style investments of its own money (USD 25-50k SAFEs, up to four startups a year, partly as design-for-equity) - a service company's own-capital angel programme, not a VC fund.

evidence.quote: Studio Ondřeje Jelínka se pouští do andělského investování – každý rok podpoří až čtyři startupy částkou 25 až 50 tisíc dolarů.
Jedním z prvních projektů, které studio svou investicí podpořilo, byla inkubace startupu Rendero zaměřeného na generování architektonických vizualizací pomocí AI.
We design brands, websites, and products, and invest in founders we believe in.
We invest in your company and provide strategic design support as part of the partnership.
We partner with early-stage founders who see quality design as a must, not a nice-to-have.

analyst_notes: Quick exclusion dossier (S1). TRAU s.r.o. (IČO 10694498, Praha 2, founded 2021 by Ondřej Jelínek) is a design studio; its 'Venture' service tier offers 'Hybrid cash & equity compensation' with a 'USD 25-50k SAFE deal' (own site, e4) and Lupa (2026-05-21) reports it is starting angel investing with up to four startups a year at USD 25-50k (e1). Dominant activity is design services (E1-type); investing is the studio's own balance-sheet money, so typed private_investor with the corporate flag (no closed-list type fits a service company's angel programme). Stage derived: the site targets 'early-stage founders' (e5; 'From Seed to Series A and beyond' for design work) and the cheques are USD 25-50k SAFEs (e1), i.e. pre-seed/seed size. No dated investment found: Rendero incubation (e2) is undated; the 2026-05-21 article announces the start of the programme (a launch, not activity). BUDETO's site lists an investor 'Traun' in Vetstor, possibly this studio - unconfirmed. Even if retyped, it would fail I3 on current evidence.
